adminWithdraw(address,address,uint256).details: The recipient is supplied per-call so the admin can route to         a future liquidity-add contract without ever embedding a         hard-coded EOA. Admin authority is presumed multisig-held.

adminWithdrawEth(address,uint256).details: Included as a safety hatch — accumulated WETH is the expected         currency, but if ETH ever lands here (e.g. via selfdestruct         or coinbase rewards), the admin can recover it.

params.weth_: The WETH address on this chain.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

adminWithdraw(address,address,uint256).notice: Sweeps an ERC20 balance to a chosen recipient. Admin only.

adminWithdrawEth(address,uint256).notice: Sweeps native ETH to a chosen recipient. Admin only.

balanceOf(address).notice: Returns the balance of an arbitrary ERC20 held here.

balances().notice: Returns this contract's LAYER and WETH balances in one call.

layerToken().notice: The LAYER token address (immutable, set at construction).

weth().notice: The WETH address (immutable, set at construction).
